mapper.select: SELECT ad_id, title FROM ad WHERE ad_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler})

SELECT ad_id, COALESCE(optimization_type,'CPC') AS optimization_type, COALESCE(target_cpa,0) AS target_cpa FROM ad WHERE ad_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler})

SELECT a.ad_id, COALESCE(a.item_id,0) AS item_id, a.advertiser_id, COALESCE(a.quality_score,0) AS quality_score FROM ad a JOIN advertiser adv ON adv.advertiser_id=a.advertiser_id AND adv.status <> 'paused' WHERE a.status='active' AND a.review_status='approved' AND a.ad_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler})
SELECT ad_id, COALESCE(MAX(bid),0) AS bid FROM bidword WHERE ad_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler}) GROUP BY ad_id
SELECT ad_id, audience_id FROM ad WHERE audience_id IS NOT NULL AND ad_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler})
SELECT ad_id, id AS bidword_id, keyword, bid FROM bidword WHERE keyword = ANY(#{keywords,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.TextListTypeHandler}) ORDER BY bid DESC LIMIT #{limit}
